claim: With 5 or 20 labelled examples per class the best decision model used zero-shot with label names only (no task labels) outperforms every compact classifier tested
runs_or_file: reports/contrasts.csv P2N rows k=5 and k=20 (post-hoc family after external review); P2 rows with D
population: Banking77, MASSIVE-it historical samples; Ottavo synthetic
limits: P2N added after the main analysis; synthetic Ottavo; intent tasks only

claim: With full training data and the protocol recipes, the best decision model with label names leads by 2.4 points on Banking77 and 5.5 on MASSIVE-it; on Ottavo the difference is not resolved
limits: recipe-dependent: on Banking77 the exploratory recipe removes the resolved gap (SENS); with D (P2) Banking77 +0.014 not resolved

claim: On Italian MASSIVE the best decision model leads the best compact classifier with full data by about 6 points

The exploratory score of Qwen3-0.6B on Banking77 (0.940) is reproduced with the exploratory recipe, but the claim that it beats Mammoth-1 is not: the difference is not resolved (this does not show equivalence)
estimate_ci: exploratory recipe 0.936 (4 train seeds, 0.931-0.940) vs protocol recipe 0.910: +0.026 [+0.018,+0.035]; Mammoth-1 D minus it -0.011 [-0.025,+0.002], N -0.002 [-0.014,+0.011]; official test same picture
population: Banking77 historical sample and full official test
limits: recipes differ in schedule / data share / epoch selection (not separated); not run on other datasets

claim: The 5-shot collapse of decoder classifiers with a fresh head persists with both recipes tested
limits: two recipes and a small grid; LM-head variant not tested

claim: Among the compact methods evaluated, SetFit is the best with 5 examples per class and the only one above 0.6 macro-F1 on every dataset
estimate_ci: 0.717/0.615/0.766; others below 0.6 on at least one dataset

claim: The effect of category descriptions varies with model and dataset: large for OpenAI on Banking77, positive for all models on Ottavo, small and mixed elsewhere
estimate_ci: OpenAI Banking77 +0.071 [+0.051,+0.093]; Elephant MASSIVE-it +0.037 [+0.001,+0.060] p_Holm 0.31; Base Labs Banking77 -0.009/-0.010 (full test -0.007/-0.008, p_Holm 0.22/0.045)
limits: descriptions for public datasets written from labelled training examples; possible contamination

claim: Descriptions help all three decision models on Ottavo
Elephant-1 and Mammoth-1 are insensitive to option order; OpenAI and Qwen3-8B are not
estimate_ci: Base Labs 100% agreement; OpenAI range up to 0.048

claim: In-context examples help OpenAI on Banking77 only; 10 retrieved examples match 20 per class at 1/10 of the cost
Elephant-1 is much closer to its own base checkpoint Qwen3.5-9B (zero-shot) than to Qwen3-8B; the remaining gap is small and larger on the stress set
limits: not a causal ablation (attention mask, objective, precision, serving differ); 4-bit progenitor

claim: Decision models do not lose accuracy on the lexical stress test, compact classifiers lose 1.6-6 points
Base Labs models give better probabilities for routing to human review than OpenAI on Banking77
limits: cross-fitted thresholds on test halves; no real traffic
